Each component in the table was used to direct data collection and analysis. We achieved varying degrees of success, given the disparate structures and natures of the collaborations. As shown in Figure 1, more than half of the collaborations studied for this report receive public funding. As shown in Figure 2, approximately one third of the collaborations that we studied are structured around an open source software development effort. Community, collaborative and non-profit software projects benefit from having an umbrella organization to help manage governance and, in particular, funding. Umbrella organizations such as the Linux Foun- dation [14] and the OpenJS Foundation [3] provide homes for projects that require long-term maintenance with cross-institution collaboration opportunities. Unlike purely community projects, high-level governance permits additional funding methods along with formal project governance, allowing collaborators to have guidance for IP sharing, data products, and usage. In industry, the PCI-SIG [15] is an example of a collaboration that both fulfills a key need and has successfully established itself as a player in the technology and computing world. This leads to a long-term sustainability challenge, as it is unclear that an organization based on standards development could provide similar value to its members in the accelerator community. 3.3 State of AI/ML Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) are in widespread use across particle accelerator ex- perimental facilities, as well as security and defense installations. For the particle accelerator community, production use cases for facility operations are primarily limited to image recognition and processing. The development of such technologies in the private sector has strongly impacted both funding and research priorities within scientific and academic institutions. Operational facilities and control systems have very different requirements from the cutting-edge of technology, though, with a need for reliability and quantifi- ability.
